echo_sets.name: Void Thunder
echo_sets.note: Best-in-slot for Electro DPS; 5-pc grants up to 40% Electro DMG. Nightmare: Thundering Mephis is Game8's main-echo pick over the older Thundering Mephis.

echo_sets.name: Lingering Tunes
echo_sets.note: ATK-heavy alternative with a strong main-echo nuke; documented by GameRant and TheGamer.

echo_sets.name: Void Thunder + Lingering Tunes
echo_sets.note: 10% Electro DMG plus 10% ATK while farming a full 5-piece set.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; no special Energy Regen requirement
build.fast_path: Fast path: Lustrous Razor + 5-piece Void Thunder in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Nightmare: Thundering Mephis in the main slot. Crit on the 4-cost, Electro DMG on the 3-costs, ATK% on the 1-costs, and chase Resonance Liberation DMG substats.

ranked_weapons.name: Lustrous Razor
ranked_weapons.note: His signature; bundles ATK, Energy Regen, and Resonance Liberation DMG in one package.

ranked_weapons.name: Verdant Summit
ranked_weapons.note: Jiyan's weapon, but a strong stat stick for Calcharo: 12% all-attribute DMG and Crit DMG (per Rock Paper Shotgun and TheGamer).

ranked_weapons.name: Autumntrace
ranked_weapons.note: Stacks ATK% on Basic and Heavy Attacks — VGC rates it one of the best returns on investment of his options.

ranked_weapons.name: Helios Cleaver
ranked_weapons.note: Crit Rate substat; a widely available alternative per GameRant.

ranked_weapons.name: Guardian Broadblade
ranked_weapons.note: Free 3-star option that directly boosts Basic and Heavy Attack DMG (per TheGamer).

profile.role_note: Classic standard-banner Electro main DPS; long on-field Liberation combos.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: A standard-banner 5-star Electro carry who has aged out of the meta — free and perfectly serviceable, but newer Electro DPS options outclass him.

members.name: Calcharo
members.note: Electro broadblade carry; his Heavy Attack: Death Messenger counts as Liberation DMG.

members.name: Jianxin
members.note: Outro amplifies the next character's Resonance Liberation DMG; also groups and shields.

teams.name: Calcharo + Jianxin + Verina
teams.rotation: Jianxin groups enemies and Outros into Calcharo for the Liberation DMG amp, Verina keeps the team alive and deepens damage, then Calcharo runs his Death Messenger burst window.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Fast Concerto builder; Outro buffs Basic Attack DMG.

teams.name: Calcharo + Sanhua + Verina
teams.rotation: Sanhua builds Concerto quickly and Outros into Calcharo for the Basic Attack buff, Verina sustains, then Calcharo executes his full burst combo.

tier_badge.note: Beebom's 3.7 tier list places Calcharo in B; MMO Culture's 3.6 list also rates him B. Game8's tier-list page itself could not be verified.

sequences.verdict: S1 is the first jump; S3 is the most efficient mid-range stop, S6 only for whales (dupes accumulate on the standard banner).
